description: Ministry of Ports & Shipping - the Shipping Agents, freight Forwarders, Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier and Container Operators (Structure of Charges) Regulations 2017
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping under the Licensing of Shipping Agents, Freight Forwarders, Non-Vessel Operating Common Carriers and Container Operators Act, No. 10 of 1972. It establishes new regulatory requirements for shipping documentation, freight charges, and compliance procedures. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it creates new subsidiary legislation and regulatory frameworks for maritime commerce operations.
